consequence.statement: Clusters not deployed via Flux Operator must run `flux migrate` before upgrading, because the v1beta1 and v2beta1 APIs have been removed from the CRDs.
consequence.remediation: Run `flux migrate` on the cluster before upgrading to Flux 2.7; see the Flux v2.7 upgrade guide.

original.statement: Flux APIs v1beta1 and v2beta1 were removed from the CRDs; unless Flux Operator deploys the controllers, `flux migrate` must be run on clusters before upgrading to 2.7.

decision.reason: [ev-82be76c03b0e] says the v1beta1 and v2beta1 Flux APIs have been removed from the CRDs. It also says that, unless Flux Operator deploys the controllers, "you must run the `flux migrate` command on clusters before upgrading". That is a mandatory operator step before the upgrade, so migration-required (mandatory work) is the right kind. The proposed statement and remediation repeat the evidence's terms without over-claiming.
